No return date or planned length of visit is given, so there is no stated basis for an intention to leave at the end of the visit.","whatWouldHelp":"A defined itinerary with fixed dates and return travel arrangements, plus evidence of circumstances that require a return.","concern":true},{"criterionId":"crit_a1953936aa9bb049","detail":"The applicant has no property and no family where they live, has most of their close family in the UK, and has an open-ended stay. Together these raise a question about whether the UK could become their main home.","whatWouldHelp":"Evidence of an established life in the country of residence and a fixed, limited visit duration.","concern":true},{"criterionId":"crit_e15f6548bcd161d4","detail":"The intake records the purpose as tourism. The statement describes visiting siblings. The two sources do not match, and the stated purpose is unclear.","whatWouldHelp":"A consistent explanation of the visit purpose and planned activities.","concern":true},{"criterionId":"crit_82884e5d69bb3ccf","detail":"The applicant is unemployed, has home ties recorded as none stated, has no property or family where they live, and has two siblings and most close family in the UK. This closely matches the guidance example of a person with few ties to their home country.","whatWouldHelp":"Evidence of family, economic, social, study or other commitments in the country of residence.","concern":true},{"criterionId":"crit_77c35c7610d721b5","detail":"No personal or economic ties to the country of residence are evidenced. The applicant has no job and no property, and the statement says there is no family where they live.","whatWouldHelp":"Documentary evidence of ties such as tenancy, community involvement, job prospects or study enrolment.","concern":true},{"criterionId":"crit_7256046bc8894bc6","detail":"Monthly income is 0 and the applicant is unemployed. The family background points to the UK rather than the country of residence.","whatWouldHelp":"An explanation of how the applicant supports themselves and of the source of their savings.","concern":true},{"criterionId":"crit_01aa3b76aa14511b","detail":"Savings are 3000 against a stated trip cost of 2500, with no income and monthly commitments of 100. This leaves a small margin, and the stay length is undefined, so likely costs may exceed the stated trip cost. Spending most of their savings on the trip may not be reasonable given no income.","whatWouldHelp":"A trip cost breakdown tied to a fixed duration, and evidence of remaining resources after the trip.","concern":true},{"criterionId":"crit_a6efd28d5c5e8b21","detail":"No source of revenue continues during the visit. Accommodation arrangements are not stated, although siblings in the UK are mentioned. The cost of the stay cannot be assessed against an open-ended duration.","whatWouldHelp":"Accommodation details and a defined duration with a costed budget.","concern":true},{"criterionId":"crit_c832ab9cd1a8bc8b","detail":"Monthly commitments of 100 are declared with no income to meet them. The nature of these commitments is not specified.","whatWouldHelp":"Details of what the ongoing commitments are and how they will be met during and after the visit.","concern":true},{"criterionId":"crit_aadfe74b10983a2c","detail":"The applicant holds 3000 in savings with no income and is unemployed. Immigration history therefore offers no positive indication either way.","whatWouldHelp":"Details of any previous international travel and compliance.","concern":false},{"criterionId":"crit_5175afe9469a7d4c","detail":"The extraction indicates the funds are held in a permitted financial institution, with no overdraft facility, and the evidence is dated 20 days before the application.
